nodes.label: HtmlParser
nodes.desc: Parses Angular template HTML into a mutable AST via the lexer-driven ml_parser.

nodes.label: htmlAstToRender3Ast()
nodes.desc: Transforms the HTML AST into an R3TemplateAst carrying bindings, variables and blocks.

nodes.label: R3TargetBinder
nodes.desc: Binds directives and pipes in the template AST to metadata so codegen knows every target.

nodes.label: NgCompiler
nodes.desc: The ngtsc orchestrator: drives analysis, resolution, template type checking and code emission.

nodes.label: compileComponentFromMetadata()
nodes.desc: Turns bound component metadata into the partial declaration consumed by the runtime.

nodes.label: ɵɵdefineComponent
nodes.desc: Registers the compiled component definition: view structure encoded as creation and update blocks.

nodes.label: R3Injector
nodes.desc: Environment injector that resolves providers, injector defs and injector initializers.

nodes.label: ɵɵdirectiveInject
nodes.desc: Instruction behind inject(): walks element injectors first, then the environment injector.

nodes.label: refreshView()
nodes.desc: Executes one dirty view: refreshes embedded views, components, then replays the update block.

nodes.label: ChangeDetectionSchedulerImpl
nodes.desc: Coalesces dirty notifications and notifies ApplicationRef when a refresh is due.

nodes.label: signal()
nodes.desc: Writable signal factory; writes mark reading views dirty for the next refresh.

nodes.label: ApplicationRef
nodes.desc: Owns attached views and tick(): reacts to scheduler notifications and runs global change detection.
